thread:
incident-bot: PAGING: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts for tenant heliosai on eu-west-1-dedicated-3. 5m error rate ~18%, spike started 1958002000. @mike_oncall please respond. PagerDuty: P1.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: PD-48231 -> oncall: mike_oncall. Notify: #incidents, #eng-runtime.

mike_oncall: I'm on it. Joining the call. Initial look: gateway logs show repeated 504s, runtime returning 500s intermittently.

mike_oncall: Quick triage notes:
- gateway upstream latency jumps when heliosai traffic hits certain runtime pods
- health probes ok, but per-tenant KV cache miss ratio spiked from 2% to 72%
- see many parallel long-poll streams from a single client id (likely batch of replayed jobs)

jenna_sre: I can confirm noisy behavior on 3 pods in eu-west-1-dedicated-3. GPU util ~65-80% but host mem and allocator churn very high. Looks like KV cache thrash -> GC pressure -> 5xx.

jenna_sre: quick query from observability:```promql
sum(rate(runtime_request_errors_total{cluster="eu-west-1-dedicated-3",tenant="heliosai"}[1m])) by (pod)
```
shows pods heliosai-runtime-7f6, heliosai-runtime-9c2, heliosai-runtime-11b are hot.

sara_ops: Helen, customer (heilosai support) flagged that several customers are seeing failures and retries. Do we have impact numbers?

helen_cs: heliosai-support: Confirmed: about ~28% of chat completions failing for end-users, mostly during peak batch windows. They started throttling client retries but still hitting platform errors. They're asking for ETA.

ryan_dedicated: We have a spare dedicated pool in eu-west-1-dedicated-spare-1. Options: 1) shift heliosai entirely to spare pool (fast but looks like migration) 2) apply per-tenant QPS cap and model-fallback to a smaller variant to reduce KV working set 3) evict offending worker pods (force restart) while draining traffic.

mike_oncall: I'm going to apply an emergency routing override: route 30% of heliosai traffic to spare pool and enable per-tenant qps=80 for 10m to throttle bursts. Command (router API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://platform.internal/api/v1/routing/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"heliosai","split":{"eu-west-1-dedicated-spare-1":0.3,"eu-west-1-dedicated-3":0.7},"qps_cap":80,"ttl":600}'
```
Applying now.

incident-bot: Routing override applied by mike_oncall at 1958002520.

jenna_sre: After routing change, I see immediate drop in error rate for heliosai on the overloaded pods. 5xx went from 18% -> 6% within 60s. KV miss ratio dropping.

mike_oncall: Also triggered a forced restart on the two hottest pods to clear allocator fragmentation:```bash
kubectl rollout restart deploy/heliosai-runtime -n eu-west-1-dedicated-3 --selector=pod=heliosai-runtime-7f6,heliosai-runtime-9c2
```
Restarted at 1958002575.

helen_cs: Drafting a customer message now. Proposed text: "We're aware of elevated errors impacting your production traffic. We've applied a temporary routing change and throttling to reduce failures. We're continuing to investigate root cause and will follow up with timeline. If you'd like a dedicated call, we can set one up in the next hour." Thoughts?

helen_cs: (added to heliosai-support thread) heliosai-support: sent short notification and asked for logs for the client id using long streams. They replied with request ids and said they'll pause large replay jobs for now.

jenna_sre: After the restart + routing, 5xx for heliosai stabilized to ~1.2% over the last 5m and p50 latency returned to baseline. CPU/mem metrics show host allocator recovered.

ryan_dedicated: We should schedule a controlled tenant migration to spare pool for a full snapshot/memory profile during maintenance window. Also want to run a workload replay in staging to reproduce.

mike_oncall: Agree. For now putting a 30m hold on routing override extension; will handoff to sara_ops at 1958006000 for long-term mitigation.

incident-bot: Oncall handoff scheduled: mike_oncall -> sara_ops at 1958006000 (4h). Please post follow-up runbook items.

sara_ops: Taking notes: follow-ups assigned:
- run full heap/profile on affected pods (jenna_sre)
- reproduce workload in staging and test cache tuning (ryan_dedicated)
- customer follow-up with timeline & RCA ETA (helen_cs)
- consider per-tenant streaming limits in platform policy (product/infra)

helen_cs: Customer reply: "Thanks, the temporary fix helped. We'll coordinate a maintenance window for migration. We appreciate the quick response."

mike_oncall: Closing immediate paging loop. Marking incident as mitigated. Will attach logs/queries to postmortem.

jenna_sre: Quick note to postmortem: probable root cause = unbounded parallel streaming workload from a single tenant causing KV cache churn and allocator-induced 5xx. Mitigations that helped: routing split, pod restarts, temporary QPS cap. Longer term: per-tenant stream limits + better cache eviction heuristics.

mike_oncall: Thanks team. If anyone else sees regressions ping me or escalate to P2.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 1958002708. Postmortem ticket created: PM-9213.
